Covers what they added for creators in 2025–2026. As of 2026-11-01. helpx.adobe.com returned 403 to direct fetches, so the Adobe help-page citations come from search snippets. Every other claim was checked on the cited page.

tools.name: Adobe Premiere (desktop; renamed from Premiere Pro with 26.0)
tools.positioning: The industry-standard NLE, turning into an AI hub: Firefly models plus outside partner models inside the timeline, AI masking, text-based assembly and a large audio AI push. Most of its 2026 releases mix film/TV items (Color Mode, camera RAW, Productions, Frame.io) with creator items (captions, generative B-roll and sound effects, podcast audio).
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Ecosystem lock-in (Creative Cloud, After Effects, Frame.io, Firefly credits), caption tools with translation, generative fill for missing coverage, and a free iPhone app that sends projects to the desktop.

headline_features.detail: Extends a video or audio clip using the Firefly Video Model. 4K and vertical supported at GA, and output carries Content Credentials. In 26.5 it runs on 360p through 4K UHD, any aspect ratio, interlaced and non-square-pixel footage. Creator angle: covers a short B-roll or a reaction shot that ends too soon.
Natural-language search across terabytes of footage by object, location, camera angle and metadata (shoot date, camera).
Translates captions into 27 languages. Creator-aimed: multilingual social distribution.

Hover and click to select a person or object, or draw a box or lasso, then track it through the shot. Uses an on-device Adobe model, and shape masks track up to 20x faster. 26.2 added Sharp/Smooth edge modes, 26.3 faster tracking and Restore Mask Data, 26.5 a Sharpness slider and more objects per scene. A newer segmentation model (26.3) is beta only. Used to blur faces and isolate subjects.

Choose 'Single Word' when creating captions and each word is synced to the audio, then styled and exported. No native karaoke or word-highlight animation: users have to convert captions to graphics or buy plugins (AutoCut, Captioneer), and users in the announcement's comments asked for a highlight style.
Build a rough cut from the transcript in the Text panel: select sentences, preview them, create a new sequence. Pitched at interviews, podcasts and dialogue-heavy edits.

headline_features.feature: Generative Media Tool (Generate Video, Generate Sound Effects)
headline_features.detail: Generates video or sound effects from a text prompt directly into the timeline. Can use project frames as visual references and can be guided by the editor's voice for sound effects. Models: Adobe Firefly plus partners Google Veo, Kling, Runway and Luma, depending on region and plan. Paid with credits. Generate Soundscape (reads up to 15 s of video) and Generate Music are beta.

headline_features.feature: Enhance Audio, Separate Crosstalk, Dynamic Auto Ducking
headline_features.detail: Enhance Audio gives separate control over dialogue, music, ambience and effects. Separate Crosstalk splits overlapping speakers onto separate tracks. Dynamic Auto Ducking balances dialogue against music without keyframes. Also a new speed algorithm that keeps pitch. Creator-aimed: podcasts, interviews, talking heads.
Redesigned colour workflow: Color Controls panel, Clip Grid, layered clip/group/sequence operations. Auto Color and Style Modules were added in September 2026. Film/TV-leaning.

headline_features.feature: Firefly Boards import and automatic sequence
headline_features.detail: Import mood-board or storyboard assets from Firefly Boards. In 26.3 Premiere builds a sequence in the order they were selected. 26.0 also linked Premiere to the Firefly app's partner models (Google, OpenAI, Runway).

headline_features.feature: Content Credentials on export, Sequence Index, source-monitor waveforms
headline_features.detail: Attribution, linked accounts and AI-usage preferences written at export; a searchable spreadsheet view of the timeline; audio waveforms in the Source Monitor.

headline_features.feature: Adobe for creativity connector in Claude (hosted MCP)
headline_features.detail: Adobe and Anthropic's hosted remote MCP server: 50+ tools across Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Firefly, Premiere, Express, InDesign and Stock. Hands-on reviewers say it works at roughly Adobe Express level and does not drive the installed Premiere timeline. Community MCP servers drive desktop Premiere through its CEP/ExtendScript bridge.
Long-standing tool that reframes a sequence to square, vertical or 16:9 by following the subject. It is still Premiere's route to vertical video. No new social export preset in 26.x was found.
headline_features.as_of: 2026 (help page; fetch returned 403, seen in search results)

headline_features.detail: Nov 10–12, Miami Beach. Adobe has historically shipped major versions at MAX. A Premiere Color Mode session is on the agenda, and Adobe has said it will bring NVIDIA's RTX Spark chip to Premiere. No product announcements yet.

tools.name: Adobe Premiere on iPhone (Premiere mobile)
tools.positioning: A free, watermark-free, ad-free phone editor. It replaced Premiere Rush and competes directly with CapCut. Adobe charges only for Firefly credits and storage, and YouTube Shorts is built into the app on both sides.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Free 4K HDR editing with unlimited tracks, auto captions, Enhance Speech, generative sound effects, YouTube Shorts templates and direct publishing, and hand-off to desktop Premiere.

headline_features.detail: Free download, no watermarks or ads. Unlimited video, audio and text layers, 4K HDR export, auto captions with styled subtitles, Enhance Speech, generative sound effects from a prompt or your own voice, one-tap background removal, resize to any aspect ratio. Paid tier $7.99/mo or $69.99/yr for Firefly credits. Runs on iPhone, iPad and Vision; no Android listing as of 2026-11-01.

headline_features.feature: Create for YouTube Shorts space and 'Edit in Adobe Premiere' button
headline_features.detail: A YouTube Shorts template gallery inside Premiere mobile. When a creator allows template reuse on a Short, viewers see an 'Edit in Adobe Premiere' button that opens the template in the app. No paid subscription needed, though some AI features need one. Templates do not keep custom LUTs, custom fonts or generative AI content.

headline_features.feature: Direct publish to YouTube Shorts and remixable YouTube templates
headline_features.detail: Publish to YouTube Shorts without leaving the app, and discover remixable trending templates. Release-note dates for these entries differ between locales (December 2025, April 2026, June 2026).
headline_features.as_of: 2025-12 to 2026-06 (fetch returned 403, seen in search results)

headline_features.detail: Adobe Fonts library, a Chroma key tool, redesigned text editing, Preserve Pitch on speed changes, speed changes on audio-only clips, template clip counts shown up front, copy and paste of clips between projects, and projects bundled as a ZIP.

tools.name: DaVinci Resolve 20 (Blackmagic Design)
tools.positioning: A free or one-time-purchase (Studio, about $295 perpetual) all-in-one: edit, colour, Fusion VFX and Fairlight audio. Resolve 20 was its big creator AI release: script-to-timeline, animated subtitles, automatic multicam switching and an automatic mix.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: No subscription, a capable free tier, the Cut page for fast editing, AI tools that remove whole chores (multicam switching, mixing, silence removal), and layouts that adapt to vertical timelines.

headline_features.detail: Builds a timeline from a script: matches transcribed clips to script lines, picks the best takes, and puts alternates on extra tracks for review. Resolve 21 adds Final Draft and plain-text screenplay import.
Generates a subtitle track from transcription. Dragging an animated Fusion title template onto the track header animates each word as it is spoken (social-style word captions).
Cuts a multicam clip to the active speaker using audio and lip movement, triggered from the multicam viewer. Creator-aimed: podcasts and interviews.
Analyses timeline audio, organises tracks, evens dialogue levels, balances music and effects under dialogue, and produces a mastered mix.

IntelliCut removes silences, puts each speaker's dialogue on its own track and builds an ADR cue list from speaker labels. Voice Convert applies a voice model to a recording while keeping its inflection and emotion.

headline_features.feature: Magic Mask v2 and Set Extender
headline_features.detail: Point-based selection of people, objects or regions, with paint refinement, tracked through obstructions and low-quality footage. Set Extender generates scene extensions or new backgrounds from a text prompt.

headline_features.feature: AI Music Editor and Detect Music Beats
headline_features.detail: Lengthens or shortens a music track to fit the video, offering four versions. Beat detection puts markers on the beats so clips snap to them.

headline_features.feature: Vertical-aware page layouts and keyframe editor on Cut/Edit
headline_features.detail: When a vertical timeline loads, the Cut, Edit and Color layouts rearrange around a vertical viewer. A dedicated curve and keyframe editor arrives on the Cut and Edit pages.

tools.name: DaVinci Resolve 21 / 21.1 (Blackmagic Design)
tools.positioning: Resolve keeps adding AI tools (all Studio-only), plus a Photo page. 21.1 made it the first major NLE with a built-in MCP server, so Claude, Claude Code and Codex can drive it.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Face retouching, synthetic focus and text-to-speech built in; still a one-time price; agent control for Studio owners; HTML (OGraf) and Lottie graphics.

headline_features.detail: Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT Codex can analyse projects, organise media, adjust settings and batch render through conversation. Blackmagic's examples: highlight edits from long-form video, removing unwanted clips, rendering deliverables. Press reports the setup screen also detecting Google Antigravity and Grok. It works through the scripting API and is Studio-only, and Python scripting itself moved from free to Studio. Blackmagic warns that AI-created scripts get the assistant's own disk and network permissions. Reviewers call it 'novel but early'.
Finds people, faces, objects and dialogue keywords across media, returning whole clips in the Media Pool.
Text to speech using Blackmagic voices or a custom voice cloned from about a 10-second sample. Speed, pitch and inflection are adjustable.

headline_features.feature: CineFocus, Face Age Transformer, Face Reshaper, Blemish Removal
headline_features.detail: Click-to-focus synthetic depth of field with bokeh and keyframeable rack focus; ageing and de-ageing; reshaping facial features on a tracked face; acne and spot removal that keeps skin texture. Creator angle: talking-head beauty and 'cinematic look' fixes.
Sharpens upscaled or slightly soft footage, reduces motion-blur streaks, and reads slates into clip metadata.

headline_features.feature: Graphics: OGraf HTML, Lottie, Krokodove, emoji in text
headline_features.detail: Native OGraf HTML and Lottie support, about 70 Krokodove graphics tools in Fusion (25+ more in 21.1), and Text+ with spell check, colour fonts, emoji and per-character styling.

Subtitle inspector with search and replace, subtitle fades, better word timing, faster transcription. Bézier retiming and keyframe modes on Cut/Edit, a multicam angle preview, folder tracks, immersive VR180/360 presets for Meta Quest and YouTube.

headline_features.feature: 21.1 editing: 25 multicam angles, inspector presets, vertical source viewer
headline_features.detail: Keyboard shortcuts for up to 25 multicam angles, splitting multicam clips at timecode gaps, saved inspector presets, and a source viewer that keeps the source's aspect ratio in a vertical timeline. Also marker reports as PDF and 20 new scripting APIs.

Free iPhone camera app. Version 2.0 (2024) added multi-iPhone control and monitoring of up to nine cameras. Version 3.3 (April 2026) adds Apple Watch control and ATEM camera control, so an iPhone works as a live studio camera.

tools.name: Final Cut Pro for Mac 11–12.4 (Apple)
tools.positioning: Apple-silicon-native, magnetic-timeline editor, now the anchor of the Apple Creator Studio subscription. Its AI runs on-device and targets creators' chores (captions, search, masks, beat sync, thumbnails). Apple has announced no conversational assistant or MCP for Final Cut Pro.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Speed on Apple silicon, the magnetic timeline for quick short-form cuts, AI that runs on the Mac, a one-time $299.99 option that still gets updates, and the iPhone/iPad ecosystem (Final Cut Camera, Live Multicam).

headline_features.feature: Magnetic Mask; Transcribe to Captions; spatial video editing
headline_features.detail: Isolates people and objects without a green screen. Captions from speech on the Mac (Apple silicon, macOS Sequoia+). Imports and edits spatial video from Vision Pro and iPhone 15 Pro+. Also 120 fps timelines and Picture in Picture.

headline_features.feature: Transcript Search, Visual Search, Beat Detection
headline_features.detail: Search spoken words exactly or by meaning; find shots by describing objects or actions in natural language; analyse a song into bars and beats on a grid so clips snap to the rhythm (uses Logic Pro's model). Search requires Apple silicon and is US English only. Apple says these also reach one-time-purchase owners.

On-device transcription places subtitles on the timeline in animated, customisable styles (font, colour, position). Requires Apple silicon and is US English only. Mac and iPad. An October 2026 announcement adds 23 transcription languages.

On-device AI detects skin, hair, sky, foliage, clothing and other subjects. Hover a clip to preview a detection or pick one from the inspector, then pair it with colour correction or effects. Mac only.

headline_features.feature: Edit Detection, Match Color, Pixelmator Pro frame send
headline_features.detail: Splits a flattened, rendered video back into its shots with one click; a rebuilt colour match across cameras; one-click send of any frame to Pixelmator Pro for custom thumbnails and social graphics. Available to one-time owners as well as subscribers.

headline_features.feature: Cinematic mode editing from Final Cut Camera
headline_features.detail: Edit Cinematic-mode depth effects recorded in Final Cut Camera. Requires macOS 27.

headline_features.feature: MotionVFX built in, Content Hub, Pixelmator round trip, 23 transcription languages
headline_features.detail: Apple bought MotionVFX in March 2026. Its thousands of templates, titles, transitions, graphics, rotoscoping, tracking and grading tools are now built into Final Cut Pro, alongside Content Hub stock video, photos and backgrounds. Also: edit a timeline image in Pixelmator Pro and return it to the timeline, finer keyframe easing, clips that can sit anywhere off the storyline, and 23 more transcription languages. Due as a free update in November 2026. Unclear how much of the content one-time owners get.

tools.name: Final Cut Pro for iPad 2.x–3.4 (Apple)
tools.positioning: Apple's touch editor, the most creator- and phone-oriented of its pro apps: multi-iPhone shooting, automatic montages and creator themes for several aspect ratios.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Live Multicam from several iPhones, Montage Maker for quick highlight reels cut to music, portrait-orientation editing and Final Cut Camera.

headline_features.detail: Connects up to four iPhones or iPads running Final Cut Camera, previews and controls them, and syncs the angles. Used for podcasts, interviews and music videos.

Picks visual highlights from your media and cuts them to a chosen song's beat. Auto Crop reframes dynamically to keep faces and other areas of interest in frame, and 3.3 adds a slip tool. Requires iPadOS 26.

headline_features.feature: Transcript Search, Visual Search, Beat Detection on iPad
headline_features.detail: Same search and beat tools as the Mac version (iPadOS 26).

headline_features.feature: Generate Captions and Creator Themes with multiple aspect ratios
headline_features.detail: Caption generation (US English only), and creator title/graphics themes built for several aspect ratios at once.

headline_features.feature: Portrait orientation, Enhance Light and Color
headline_features.detail: Edit holding the iPad upright (2.2), and one-tap machine-learning correction of colour, contrast and brightness (2.1).

tools.name: Apple Creator Studio (bundle)
tools.positioning: Apple's answer to Creative Cloud: one subscription for Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor and MainStage, plus premium iWork content. Apple says 'intelligence features' are exclusive to subscribers.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: $12.99/mo or $129/yr (students $2.99/mo) instead of about $650 in one-time purchases. Family sharing, Mac and iPad, and bundled MotionVFX content from November 2026.

headline_features.detail: Mac gets all six apps; iPad gets Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro and Pixelmator Pro. One-time purchases remain (Final Cut Pro $299.99). Projects in Final Cut Pro, Logic and Pixelmator need an active subscription to open or edit after cancelling. Apple's page says intelligence features are subscriber-exclusive, although 12.0–12.3 AI features did reach one-time owners.

headline_features.feature: October 2026 update: AI assistants and MCP (not in Final Cut Pro)
headline_features.detail: Beta AI assistants in Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages and Numbers (Apple and OpenAI models), and MCP support in Keynote, Pages and Numbers so outside agents can work in documents. Final Cut Pro, Motion and Pixelmator Pro get neither. Pixelmator Pro gets Generate Fill. Due in November 2026.

tools.name: LumaFusion (LumaTouch)
tools.positioning: Long-running mobile-first pro NLE for iPhone, iPad, Mac (Apple silicon), Android and ChromeOS. Releases are steady but incremental, AI is deliberately limited to on-device non-creative helpers, and pro features are upsold as add-ons or a Creator Pass.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: A one-time $29.99 price, a deep touch timeline, an optional Multicam Studio, export up to 8K, and FCPXML hand-off to desktop.

headline_features.feature: Adjustment clips; 12 video and 12 audio tracks; SVG shapes
headline_features.detail: Adjustment clips, a higher track limit and SVG shape import.

headline_features.feature: Video plugins (CoreMelt PaintX), audio ducking, spatial audio export
headline_features.detail: First third-party video plugin category (PaintX, a $19.99 add-on), audio ducking and spatial audio export.

headline_features.feature: 5K/6K/8K export, background export, macOS menu bar
headline_features.detail: Higher-resolution export on newer devices and export that runs in the background.

headline_features.feature: Multicam Studio and AI Person Keyer
headline_features.detail: Syncs up to six cameras or audio sources and switches angles with a tap ($19.99 add-on or Creator Pass at $9.99/mo or $69.99/yr). The AI Person Keyer replaces the background behind people for free. On-device voice isolation. No automatic captions found in the listing.
Apply one transition to several clips, head-and-tail dissolves, and APV codec export (about 20% smaller files).

headline_features.feature: Title editor overhaul, image background removal
headline_features.detail: Title-editor tools, background removal and cropping for images in titles (5.5.x), and new Reflected Tiles effects (5.6.1).

tools.name: Edits (Meta/Instagram) — newcomer
tools.positioning: A free, watermark-free mobile editor from a platform owner, built to feed Instagram Reels. It ties editing to the creator's own account analytics and adds an AI assistant that reads those metrics.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Free, posts straight to Instagram and Facebook, offers caption styles, green screen and AI animation, and shows Reels analytics beside the edit.

headline_features.detail: Frame-accurate timeline, auto-captions, overlays, built-in green-screen camera, AI image animation, project management, watermark-free export and direct posting to Instagram and Facebook. Requires an Instagram account.

headline_features.feature: 2026 updates: bilingual captions, 15-minute exports, Kits, beat-synced effects
headline_features.detail: Automatic bilingual captions, AI restyling and 15-minute exports (August 2026); reusable style Kits and 50 effects (mid-October); caption styles, bulk caption editing and beat-synced effects (late October). Desktop version still 'coming soon'. Sourced from trade press, not Meta's own posts.
AI chat that analyses the creator's own retention and share metrics and suggests ideas. Free with a daily limit.

tools.name: Descript (Underlord) — agentic newcomer
tools.positioning: Transcript-first editor whose rebuilt Underlord is an agentic co-editor: you describe the result, and it plans and runs multi-step edits with Descript's own tools.
tools.why_creators_pick_it: Podcast and talking-head creators can go from a single prompt to a styled rough cut with B-roll, Studio Sound, Eye Contact, captions, automatic multicam and chapters.

headline_features.detail: From one prompt it can generate a rough cut, remove retakes, style visuals, add B-roll and captions, apply Eye Contact and Studio Sound, add automatic multicam and chapter markers, translate, and generate images or video. Turned on in Labs. Reviews report a model picker that includes Claude, and that chat messages use AI credits.

trends.trend: Agents and MCP move into the NLE itself
trends.evidence: Resolve 21.1 (Sep 2026) ships a built-in MCP server for Claude, Claude Code and Codex, but only in Studio, through the scripting API, and with Python scripting moved to Studio as well. Adobe's hosted 'Adobe for creativity' connector in Claude (Apr 2026) reaches Premiere only at about Express level, and community MCP servers drive desktop Premiere through its CEP bridge. Apple adds MCP to Keynote, Pages and Numbers but not Final Cut Pro (announced Oct 2026). After Effects has an AI Assistant in public beta, Descript's Underlord and Meta's Edits Assistant are in-app agents. No incumbent offers every edit as a free, open, local MCP tool together with an in-app assistant.

trends.trend: Natural-language search of your own footage
trends.evidence: Premiere Media Intelligence (GA Apr 2025), Final Cut Pro 12 Transcript Search and Visual Search (Jan 2026, on-device, Mac and iPad), and Resolve 21 IntelliSearch (people, faces, objects, dialogue). All three majors shipped it within about 12 months.

trends.trend: One-click subject masking replaces rotoscoping and green screen
trends.evidence: Final Cut Pro Magnetic Mask (Nov 2024) and Auto Mask (Jun 2026), Premiere Object Mask (Jan 2026, on-device, improved in each later release), Resolve Magic Mask v2 (2025), Premiere on iPhone one-tap background removal, the LumaFusion AI Person Keyer, and Edits' green screen. Creators use these to blur faces, isolate a subject to grade, and put text behind a person.

trends.trend: Word-level, animated, multilingual captions are now native
trends.evidence: Resolve 20 AI Animated Subtitles (2025), Premiere Single-Word Captions (Jun 2026, no karaoke highlight yet, which users ask for), Final Cut Pro Generate Captions with animated styles (Jun 2026, US English, 23 languages announced), Premiere Caption Translation into 27 languages (Apr 2025), and Edits' automatic bilingual captions (Aug 2026).

trends.trend: Assembling a cut from the transcript or script
trends.evidence: Premiere Paper Edit (Sep 2026), Resolve IntelliScript (2025; screenplay import in 21), and Descript Underlord's prompt-to-rough-cut. Silence and filler removal (Resolve IntelliCut) has become the baseline beneath them.

trends.trend: Automatic multicam, especially for podcasts and interviews
trends.evidence: Resolve Multicam SmartSwitch cuts to the active speaker using audio and lip movement (2025), and Resolve 21.1 adds shortcuts for 25 angles. Final Cut Pro for iPad Live Multicam records from up to four iPhones. Blackmagic Camera turns iPhones into a multi-camera rig with ATEM control. Descript offers 'automatic multicam', and LumaFusion sells Multicam Studio.

trends.trend: Audio AI shifts from noise removal to separating sources and mixing automatically
trends.evidence: Resolve AI Audio Assistant (an automatic mastered mix) and IntelliCut (per-speaker tracks), Premiere Enhance Audio (separate dialogue, music, ambience and effects), Separate Crosstalk and Dynamic Auto Ducking (public beta Sep 2026), and Logic Pro's Stem Splitter in Creator Studio.

trends.trend: Music-driven editing: beat grids, music fitting, automatic montages
trends.evidence: Final Cut Pro 12 Beat Detection (Mac and iPad), Final Cut Pro for iPad Montage Maker (highlights cut to the beat, with Auto Crop), Resolve 20 Detect Music Beats and AI Music Editor (lengthen or shorten a track to fit), Premiere Generate Music (beta), and Edits' beat-synced effects.

trends.trend: Generative fill for missing media, increasingly from several vendors' models
trends.evidence: Premiere Generative Extend (GA Apr 2025, now any aspect ratio up to 4K) and the Generative Media Tool (Sep 2026: Firefly plus Veo, Kling, Runway and Luma, paid with credits), Resolve Set Extender (2025) and Speech Generator with voice cloning (2026), and generative sound effects on Premiere on iPhone. Content Credentials are written on export.

trends.trend: Vertical and multi-aspect output treated as first-class
trends.evidence: Resolve 20 rearranges its layouts around a vertical viewer and 21.1 keeps the source aspect in vertical timelines. Final Cut Pro for iPad 3.3 has Creator Themes built for several aspect ratios, and Final Cut Pro offers automatic reframing. Premiere Auto Reframe, and Premiere on iPhone resizes for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. An example of Resolve's MCP in use is reframing a timeline to 9:16.

trends.trend: Editors tied to platforms: templates, remixing, direct publishing
trends.evidence: Premiere mobile's Create for YouTube Shorts space, the 'Edit in Adobe Premiere' button on Shorts, and direct publishing to Shorts (Dec 2025). Edits publishes to Instagram and Facebook and shows Reels analytics beside the edit, with an assistant that reads them. Final Cut Pro 12.3 sends frames to Pixelmator Pro for thumbnails.

trends.trend: Bundled template and stock libraries as a selling point
trends.evidence: Apple bought MotionVFX in March 2026 and builds its thousands of templates, plus Content Hub stock, into Final Cut Pro (announced Oct 2026). Premiere added more than 90 Film Impact effects and transitions in 2026, Resolve 21 added Krokodove plus Lottie and OGraf HTML graphics, and Edits has reusable Kits.

trends.trend: The phone as camera and first editor, handing off to desktop
trends.evidence: Premiere on iPhone (free, Sep 2025) sends projects to the desktop. Final Cut Camera feeds Live Multicam, and Cinematic-mode clips became editable in 12.4. Blackmagic Camera 3.3 adds ATEM control. LumaFusion runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

trends.trend: Pricing splits into subscriptions with metered AI credits versus perpetual licences
trends.evidence: Apple Creator Studio at $12.99/mo with subscriber-exclusive intelligence features, Premiere mobile free with $7.99/mo for credits, Premiere's partner models billed per generation, Resolve Studio's roughly $295 perpetual licence gating every AI tool and now MCP, and LumaFusion's Creator Pass alongside $19.99 add-ons.

table_stakes: Automatic captions on-device or in the cloud, with word-by-word animated styles and SRT/VTT; translation into other languages is fast becoming expected (Premiere 27 languages, FCP +23 announced, Edits bilingual). Frame Job has word captions in five styles but lists no caption translation.
Clean-up of spoken recordings: silence and filler removal, voice isolation and denoise, loudness normalisation, ducking. Frame Job already has all of these.

One-click AI subject masking or background removal without a green screen (FCP Magnetic/Auto Mask, Premiere Object Mask, Resolve Magic Mask, Premiere iPhone, LumaFusion Person Keyer). Frame Job has chroma key and matte tracks but no AI subject mask.

Vertical and multi-aspect output with automatic subject-following reframe (Premiere Auto Reframe, FCP automatic reframing and Auto Crop, Resolve vertical layouts). Frame Job's spec lists auto-reframe as out of scope (now lifted).
Natural-language search of your own footage by what is seen and said (Premiere Media Intelligence, FCP Visual/Transcript Search, Resolve IntelliSearch). Not in Frame Job's feature list.
Beat detection and snapping clips to music, plus fitting music to length (FCP Beat Detection, Resolve Detect Music Beats and Music Editor). Not in Frame Job's feature list.
Multicam editing at least with manual angle switching (all four pro and prosumer tools have it). Frame Job's spec lists multicam as out of scope (now lifted).

Editing from the transcript: rough cut from selected sentences, false-start removal (Premiere Paper Edit, Resolve IntelliScript, Descript). Frame Job has transcript-driven filler cuts and get_transcript, but no text-based assembly.
A library of titles, transitions and templates, increasingly bundled (MotionVFX in FCP, Film Impact in Premiere, Krokodove in Resolve). Frame Job has 23 graphic modules.
Social export presets and fast batch export; HDR from phones handled correctly. Frame Job is strong here: HDR/HLG, AV1 and VP9, and an export queue.
differentiators: Agent control is now contested, but nobody matches the full shape. Resolve 21.1's MCP is Studio-only, goes through the scripting API, and moved Python scripting behind the paywall. Adobe's Claude connector does not drive the desktop Premiere timeline, and Apple gave MCP to iWork, not Final Cut Pro. A free, open-source editor that exposes every edit as an MCP tool with undo-safe, refusal-aware ops, plus an in-app bring-your-own-key assistant, is still unique, but the window is narrowing. The edge is depth and reliability: render_frame and get_project read-back, ops that refuse with a reason. A published library of agent recipes (highlight reel, shorts from long-form, podcast cut) would show it off.

Automatic speaker-following multicam (Resolve SmartSwitch, Descript automatic multicam). Podcast and interview creators value it highly, and it builds on Frame Job's existing Synchronize Audio and speech detection.

Source separation and an automatic mix: dialogue/music/ambience split, separating crosstalk, a one-click mastered mix (Resolve AI Audio Assistant, Premiere Enhance Audio and Separate Crosstalk in beta). Frame Job's audio chain is already deep, so this would extend a strength rather than fill a gap.

Assembly from a transcript or script (Premiere Paper Edit, Resolve IntelliScript) and agentic prompt-to-rough-cut (Descript Underlord). Frame Job's transcript cache and MCP make 'cut by text' and 'rough cut by agent' natural extensions.

Generative fill with a choice of models (Premiere Generative Media Tool with Firefly, Veo, Kling, Runway and Luma; Generative Extend; Resolve Set Extender and Speech Generator with voice cloning). Bring-your-own-key generation fits Frame Job's model better than credits do.

Platform-native distribution: Premiere's YouTube Shorts templates, remix button and direct publishing; Edits posting to Instagram with analytics beside the edit; FCP's send-to-Pixelmator for thumbnails. Thumbnail creation and direct upload are cheap wins for creators.

Phone camera ecosystems: Final Cut Camera with Live Multicam on iPad, Blackmagic Camera with multi-iPhone and ATEM control, Premiere iPhone to desktop. A Mac-only editor can compete through Continuity Camera, or by importing Final Cut Camera and Cinematic-mode clips.

Face and look tools aimed at talking heads (Resolve 21 CineFocus synthetic depth of field, Blemish Removal, Face Reshaper; Descript Eye Contact). Apple's Vision framework could support some of these on-device.

Bundled premium content (Apple building MotionVFX into Final Cut Pro, announced for Nov 2026). For an open-source editor this points to a shareable template and graphic ecosystem (Frame Job's .fjgraphic) rather than a paid stock library.

Business model as a feature: Resolve is free or perpetual, FCP is a one-time purchase or a subscription, Premiere mobile is free with credits. Frame Job being free and open with bring-your-own-key AI is itself a selling point against credit-metered AI and paywalled agent access (Resolve Studio).
